entries: This weapon is actually a hollow sheath for a rapier or specially-made shortsword. The rapier or special shortsword is not included in the price of the sword cane; rapiers have their listed cost in the Player's Handbook and a specially fitted shortsword costs 20 gp instead of 10 gp but otherwise uses the normal statistics for a shortsword. Each sword cane can only accommodate the weapon it was created for. While sheathed in a sword cane, the weapon is completely hidden and only a DC 20 Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check made while holding and inspecting the cane reveals its nature as a sheath. The cane is made of strong hardwood and can be used as a weapon itself, using the listed statistics.

entries.name: Special

entries: The jagged vertebrae sword of a fishfolk warrior can barely be called a sword. Locals would say it's better described as a makeshift weapon crafted from a fish skeleton and sea trash. Its poor construction is the reason it's not often a weapon seen on land, though when used by a skilled fighter, it most certainly can be a formidable tool.

The vertebrae sword can only be used in this way 5 times before it becomes unusable as a weapon.

item.name: Nightmare Staff
entries: This twisted {@item staff|PHB} is created from the remains of a marra. It has 3 charges and regains its expended charges daily at dusk. When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you damages you while you hold this {@item staff|PHB}, you can take a Reaction to expend 1 of the {@item staff|PHB}'s charges to force the creature to make a DC 13 Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the creature sees a phantasm that causes it to have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. If the creature is already {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, it also takes {@damage 2d6} Psychic damage.

item.name: Banner of Valor
entries: At the center of this eight-foot pole is a riveted steel buckler, a means of protection for the inquisition knight who receives it. Affixed to it is a hanging custom banner. The front depicts the knight's unique sigil.

This honorific belonged to the Gnaardryn, a renowned warrior of the Arcanist Inquisition. On the backdrop of this deep-red banner is an image of a charred hand surrounded in an aura of flame. On its back is an embroidered magical scripture, imbued with the power of the {@spell Haste} spell. Once per day, you can use an Action to cast {@spell Haste} from the banner on an ally you can see within 30 ft.

item.name: Divine Remnant - Golden Femur
entries: This is the femur of a a Seraph who was present at Walstein's destruction during Gods' End.

item.name: Divine Remnant - Golden Heart
entries: This is the heart of a a Seraph who was present at Walstein's destruction during Gods' End.

item.name: Divine Remnant - Vertebra
entries: This is the vertebra of a a Seraph who was present at Walstein's destruction during Gods' End.

item.name: Shared Spirit
entries: You were killed by an Oblivion Leaper, but instead of dying, one spirit inhabited your body. You are not alone with yourself. You have taken on traits of your new passenger:
Roll {@dice 1d4} to determine the trait of your passenger

items: Overly Dramatic: Your passenger spirit makes you prone to fits of drama, overreaction, and hyperbole. You also have Advantage on Charisma ({@skill Performance}) checks.

Cautious: Your passenger spirit forces you to always think twice before acting. You have Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks; however, you can never act first in a combat. If your Initiative check would have you act first, you act second instead.

Know-it-All: Your passenger spirit was very smart, or at least thought they were. Once per adventure you can reroll an Intelligence-based ability check. However, if you fail the check twice, you insist that the wrong information is correct.

Animal Lover: You think all Beasts are loveable and misunderstood. You have Advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Animal Handling}) checks, but you have Disadvantage on your first attack against a Beast in each combat.

item.name: Agate Ring of the Order
entries: You gain one Luck Point each day, as the Lucky feat.

item.name: Amber Ring of the Order
entries: You can cast the Jolt cantrip while wearing this ring. You are Resistant to Lightning damage.

item.name: Amethyst Ring of the Order
entries: At the beginning of each turn while in combat, if you are not {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} you regain {@dice 1d3} HP.

item.name: Aquamarine Pendant of the Order
entries: You can breathe underwater.

item.name: Catseye Ring of the Order
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision}. Your {@sense Darkvision} is operative as far as your normal vision.

item.name: Chromium Ring of the Order
entries: You are Resistant to Poison damage. You can activate the ring with a command word to cast {@quickref Vision and Light||2||bright light} over a radius of 15 ft., and {@quickref Vision and Light||2||dim light} for an additional 15 ft.

item.name: Diamond Ring of the Order
entries: You can cast {@spell Cure Wounds} at will. You are Immune to Poison damage.

item.name: Garnet Ring of the Order
entries: You have a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls.

item.name: Jade Pendant of the Order
entries: Immune to Poison damage and the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

item.name: Opal Ring of the Order
entries: You have a +1 bonus to spell save DC, spell damage, and saving throws against spells and magical effects.

item.name: Ruby Ring of the Order
entries: Once per day you can use the Rogue ability Uncanny Dodge. When you are reduced to 0 HP, roll {@dice 1d3}. On a 3, you are immediately Stabilized.

item.name: Sapphire Ring of the Order
entries: You gain a Fly speed of 20. Once per rest, you can use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on a ranged attack roll against you.

entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 9}, range 150/600 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Cold damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: War Cry {@recharge 5}
entries: The giant or one creature of its choice that can see or hear it gains 16 ({@dice 2d10 + 5}) {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the start of the giant's next turn.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The giant is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 14}, {@hit 6} to hit with spell attacks). The giant has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Ethereal Sight
entries: The ghost can see 60 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The ghost makes two Withering Touch attacks.

action.name: Withering Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 4d6 + 3}) necrotic damage.

action.name: Etherealness
entries: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

action.name: Horrifying Visage
entries: Each non-undead creature within 60 feet of the ghost that can see it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. If the save fails by 5 or more, the target also ages {@dice 1d4 × 10} years. A {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the {@condition frightened} condition on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a  {@spell greater restoration} spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

action.name: Possession {@recharge}
entries: One humanoid that the ghost can see within 5 feet of it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Charisma saving throw or be possessed by the ghost; the ghost then disappears, and the target is {@condition incapacitated} and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The ghost can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being {@condition charmed} and {@condition frightened}. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies.

The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 hit points, the ghost ends it as a bonus action, or the ghost is turned or forced out by an effect like the {@spell dispel evil and good} spell. When the possession ends, the ghost reappears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the saving throw or after the possession ends.

trait.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When reduced to 0 hit points, Shreve drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until he finishes a long rest).

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: Shreve has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Shreve makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When reduced to 0 hit points, Tulaan drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until he finishes a long rest).

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: Tulaan has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tulaan makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

action.name: Shortsword

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 4} to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When reduced to 0 hit points, Tulaan drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until she finishes a long rest).

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: Tulaan has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tulaan makes two longsword attacks. If she has a shortsword drawn, she can also make a shortsword attack.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands.

action.name: Shortsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage.

action.name: Heavy Crossbow
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 3} to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d10 + 1}) piercing damage.

trait.name: Relentless Endurance
entries: When reduced to 0 hit points, Tulaan drops to 1 hit point instead (but can't do this again until she finishes a long rest).

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
entries: Tulaan has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Tulaan makes two melee attacks.

action.name: Unarmed Attack
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: Coldfire
entries: Cold damage dealt by the elemental ignores Resistance to Cold damage.

trait.name: Coldfire Form
entries: The elemental can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the elemental or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage. In addition, the elemental can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage and catches on coldfire; until someone takes an action to douse the coldfire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Illumination
entries: The elemental sheds bright light in a 30-foot radius and dim light in an additional 30 feet.

trait.name: Coldfire Aura
entries: At the end of each of the elemental's turns, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the elemental takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Cold damage. Creatures and flammable objects in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} catch on coldfire; until someone takes an action to douse the coldfire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage at the start of each of its turns..

trait.name: Coldfire Collaboration
entries: If the elemental receives the Help action,

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The elemental makes two touch attacks.

action.name: Touch
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) cold damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object, it catches on coldfire; until someone takes an action to douse the coldfire, the creature takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) cold damage at the start of each of its turns.

trait.name: Eat Fire
entries: If the torcheater flies through fire (including coldfire), it reduces the fire's area by a 1-foot cube. A fire goes out if its area is reduced to nothing. The torcheater can enter the same space as a Fire Elemental or a Coldfire Elemental. Whenever it does, and whenever it starts its turn in the same space as a Fire Elemental or a Coldfire Elemental, the elemental takes 2d4 Necrotic damage. If the torcheater hits a Fire Elemental or a Coldfire Elemental with an attack, the elemental takes 2d4 Necrotic damage instead of 1 Fire damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}1 fire damage.

trait.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries: The wraith can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@quickref difficult terrain||3}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the wraith has disadvantage on attack rolls, as well as on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight.

trait.name: Coldfire
entries: Cold damage dealt by the wraith ignores Resistance to Cold damage.

trait.name: Coldfire Aura
entries: When a creature ends its turn within 10 feet of a wraith, it takes 5 (1d10) cold damage.

action.name: Life Drain
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}21 ({@damage 4d8 + 3}) cold damage. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or its hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Create Specter
entries: The wraith targets a humanoid within 10 feet of it that has been dead for no longer than 1 minute and died violently. The target's spirit rises as a {@creature specter} in the space of its corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The {@creature specter} is under the wraith's control. The wraith can have no more than seven specters under its control at one time.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The keppmir casts one of the following spells, requiring no material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 11}):

trait.name: Ambusher
entries: The keppmir stalker has advantage on attack rolls against any creature it has {@quickref Surprise|PHB|3|0|surprised}.

trait.name: Battle Rush
entries: If the keppmir stalker takes the {@action Dash} or {@action Disengage} action, it can use a bonus action to make a gore attack.

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature other than a keppmir that ends its turn {@action grapple|PHB|grappling} or {@condition grappled} by the keppmir stalker takes 1 fire damage.

trait.name: Water Breathing
entries: The keppmir stalker can breathe only underwater. In air, it can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The keppmir stalker makes two attacks.

action.name: Gore
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage.

action.name: Spear
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The armored sea drake can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The armored sea drake has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical eﬀects.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The armored sea drake makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. It can make one tail attack in place of its two claw attacks.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d12 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 2d8 + 7}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 13} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}26 ({@damage 3d12 + 7}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 20} Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the dragon turtle and knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Steam Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: The armored sea drake exhales scalding steam in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw, taking 52 ({@damage 15d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Being underwater doesn't grant resistance against this damage.

trait.name: Creature of Shadow
entries: Venin can sense all areas of dim light or darkness within 1 mile of her aspect. Additionally, she becomes invisible when she enters an area of darkness. Any creature that can see the area of darkness she’s hiding in can make a DC 25 Wisdom (Perception) check as a reaction. On a success, that creature gains the ability to see her until Venin’s aspect moves to a new area of darkness. A creature can also make this check as an action on each of its turns. Her invisibility ends when she hits a creature with a weapon attack or leaves the area of darkness she is hiding in.

trait.name: Daemonic Glibness
entries: When Venin makes a Charisma (Deception) check, the result can’t be lower than 35. Additionally, even if she is lying, magic that determines if Venin is telling the truth always indicates that she is being truthful.

trait.name: Discorporation
entries: When reduced to 0 hit points, Venin’s aspect dissolves into a hissing pool of inky, sulfur-smelling ichor. Venin can also discorporate her aspect as an action. Afer discorporating, Venin can’t send another aspect to the Material Plane for a year and a day.

trait.name: Shadow Blade (1/Turn)
entries: When Venin hits a creature that can’t see her with a melee weapon attack, she can cause the creature to take an additional 28 (8d6) necrotic damage.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Venin makes three Morphic Blade attacks.

action.name: Morphic Blade
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 10 ft. or range 30/90 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) piercing damage.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: Venin can transform her aspect into a Small, Medium, or Large Humanoid of any description. Her statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form. She can also conjure or dismiss any nonmagical clothing or equipment as part of this transformation. Any items created in this way dissolve into black, sulfur-smelling ichor when removed from her person.

action.name: Invoke Banished Desire
entries: Venin enhances the allure of evil thoughts which the mortals around her have chosen not to act upon. Up to 20 Humanoids that aren’t hostile toward Venin within 120 feet of her must make a DC 21 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a creature is charmed by her for 1 minute, and follows her commands to the best of its ability.

action.name: Shadow Pool
entries: Venin creates a 20-foot-radius dome of magical darkness centered on herself. Each other creature in the area when the dome appears must succeed on a DC 23 Constitution saving throw or take 22 (4d10) necrotic damage. Tis area of darkness remains  or 1 minute. Venin can’t have more than three areas of darkness active at once; if she uses this action again, one area of her choice vanishes.

bonus.name: Umbral Strike
entries: While in an area of dim light or darkness, Venin’s aspect can teleport to another area of dim light or darkness she can sense.

legendary.name: Hide
entries: Venin makes a Dexterity (Stealth) check. If she’s in an area of dim light or darkness, she becomes invisible (see her Creature of Shadow trait).

legendary.name: Shadow Pool (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Venin uses her Shadow Pool action.

legendary.name: Mirror Form (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: If Venin is not invisible, she creates three illusory copies of her body. These copies occupy three spaces of her choice that she can see within 30 feet of her. She can choose to swap places with any of these copies when they appear, as part of this legendary action. The copies have the same AC as her, and 1 hit point. A copy vanishes if reduced to 0 hit points, or if Venin turns invisible.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the coldfire premonition fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The coldfire premonition has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical eﬀects.

trait.name: Coldfire
entries: The cold damage the coldfire premonition deals ignores cold resistance. Creatures immune to cold damage treat their immunity as resistance to cold damage instead.

trait.name: Coldfire Form
entries: The coldfire premonition can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the premonition or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 11 (2d10) cold damage. In addition, the premonition can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 11 (2d10) cold damage.

trait.name: Frigid Demise
entries: When the coldfire premonition dies, its body is enveloped in a coldﬁre explosion that sends frigid shards in every direction. All creatures within 30 feet of it must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

trait.name: Ignite
entries: If a creature or a flammable object takes cold damage from the coldfire premonition, the target ignites. Hot fire smothers coldfire; until the target is dealt fire damage, it takes 5 (1d10) cold damage at the start of each of its turns.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The coldfire premonition makes two attacks: one with its Bite and one with its Tail.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}23 ({@damage 3d10 + 7}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) cold damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 12} to hit, reach 20 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d8 + 7}) bludgeoning damage, and the target is knocked {@condition prone}.

action.name: Rain of Coldfire (Recharges 5-6)
entries: The coldfire premonition roars as icy shards burst from its body and rain coldfire down around it. 1d4 coldfire hailstones strike the ground at points of the premonition’s choice within 120 feet of it. Each hailstone creates a 10-foot radius patch of coldfire. Each creature that starts its turn in this area or enters it for the ﬁrst time on a turn must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw or take 16 (3d10) cold damage.

legendary.name: Tail
entries: The premonition makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Icy Shield (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The premonition casts {@spell wall of ice} (spell save DC 18).

legendary.name: Coldfire Wall (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: The premonition casts {@spell wall of fire} (spell save DC 18); the spell deals cold damage instead of fire damage when cast in this way.

immune.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: Gondul can use her action to polymorph into a wolf-humanoid hybrid or into a wolf, or back into her true form, which is humanoid. Her statistics are the same in each form unless otherwise stated. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

trait.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
entries: Gondul has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

action.name: Multiattack (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: Gondul makes two attacks: one with her Bite and one with her Claws or Spear.

action.name: Bite (Wolf or Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a {@dc 13} Constitution saving throw or be cursed with werewolf lycanthropy.

action.name: Claws (Hybrid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) slashing damage.

action.name: Spear (Humanoid Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one creature. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) piercing damage, or 6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack.

action.name: Lightning Breath (Recharges 5-6)
entries: Gondul exhales lightning in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 10 (3d6) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary.name: Move
entries: Gondul moves up to her speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Lash Out
entries: Gondul makes one attack with her Claws or her Spear.

legendary.name: Recharge (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Gondul recharges her Lightning Breath.

trait.name: Arcing Iron
entries: Hrafen's strikes are wide, hitting multiple targets. When he makes a melee weapon attack against one creature, he can also target up to 2 other creatures within his reach, using the same attack roll for each target.

trait.name: Bad Leg
entries: Hrafen's old raiding wound doesn't hinder him much in daily life, but it does make quick movement difficult. He has disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

trait.name: Raid Commander
entries: Hrafen and friendly creatures within 30 feet of him have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition frightened}.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Hrafen makes two Warhammer attacks.

action.name: +1 Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., up to three targets. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Armor-Crushing Blow
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage, and the target must make a DC 17 Dexterity or Constitution saving throw (target's choice). On a failed save, the target's armor is damaged and its AC is reduced by 2. If the target's armor is damaged in this way again, the armor is destroyed and grants no bonus to AC. This attack can't damage magical or natural armor.

reaction.name: Shield Parry
entries: While holding a shield, Hrafen adds 4 to his AC against one attack that would hit him. If the attacker is within 5 feet of him, it must succeed on a DC 17 Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

reaction.name: Valkyrie's Pinion
entries: When a creature Hrafen can see within 30 feet of him makes a saving throw, he can choose to give it either advantage or disadvantage on the roll. That creature can't be affected by this reaction again until the next dawn.

legendary.name: Reposition
entries: Hrafen moves up to half his speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Armor-Crushing Blow
entries: Hrafen makes an Armor-Crushing Blow attack.

legendary.name: Furious Recovery (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Hrafen gains 17 (1d10+12) temporary hit points. If he has half of his hit points or fewer, he gains 5 (1d10) additional temporary hit points.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Jarl Grimskjelle makes two Frosts Warhammer attacks.

action.name: Frost Warhammer
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 10} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (2d12) cold damage.

action.name: Conjured Ice Shard
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 9} to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. {@h}28 ({@damage 4d10 + 6}) bludgeoning damage. {@hom}The ice shard explodes, and the target and creatures within 15 feet of it must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or take 11 (2d10) cold damage.

action.name: Frigid Restraints (Recharges after a Shorrt or Long Rest)
entries: Jarl Grimskjelle calls jagged shards of ice from the ground in 10-foot radius centered on a point he can see within 120 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 17 Strength or Dexterity saving throw (the creature's choice) or be {@condition restrained} for 1 minute. A creature {@condition restrained} in this way can repeat its save as an action, ending the effect on itself on a success. A 5-foot patch of ice shards has an AC of 20, 25 hit points, vulnerability to fire damage, and immunity to poison and psychic damage. A creature is no longer {@condition restrained} once all spaces restraining it are cleared of ice shards.

reaction.name: Frost Shield (Recharge 6)
entries: When Jarl Grimskjelle is hit by an attack or fails a Dexterity saving throw against a spell or effect that targets him or an area that includes him, he can increase his AC or the result of his saving throw by 5 against the triggering effect. If the attack or effect still deals damage, he has resistance to the damage it deals.

monster.name: Mjork Sootling
languages: understands Ignan and Terran but can't speak

trait.name: Heated Body
entries: A creature that ends its turn grappling the sootling takes 1 fire damage.

trait.name: Smoke Sense
entries: A sootling in contact with smoke has blindsight in that smoke's area in a radius of up to 120 feet.

trait.name: Water Susceptibility
entries: For every 5 feet the sootling moves in water, or for every gallon of water splashed on it, it takes 1 cold damage.

action.name: Burn
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d4 + 2}) fire damage.

variant.name: Sootling Familiar
entries: Sootlings that have become familiars have the following trait.

entries.name: Familiar
entries: A sootling can partner with another creature as a familiar, forming a telepathic bond with this willing partner. While the two are bonded, the partner can sense what the sootling senses while they are within 1 mile of each other. If the partner harms the sootling, the sootling ends the telepathic bond and ceases being a familiar.

trait.name: False Appearance
entries: While the mud zombie remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from an oozing pile of corpse parts.

trait.name: Formless
entries: Without squeezing, the mud zombie can move through an opening a creature up to two sizes smaller can move through.

action.name: Slam
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 13}). Until this {@action grapple} ends, the target is {@condition restrained}. A mud zombie can {@action grapple} up to two creatures at a time.

action.name: Grasping Hand
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 5} to hit, {@homebrew ranged 30 ft.}, one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) {@homebrew slashing} damage. A hand continues to claw at the targeted creature for 6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) damage each round until the target escapes the claw (escape {@dc 13}).

reaction.name: Split
entries: When a mud zombie that is Medium or larger takes 10 damage or more, it splits into two new zombies if it has at least 10 hit points. Each new zombie has hit points equal to half the original zombie's, rounded down. New zombies are one size smaller than the original zombie.

trait.name: Bloody Inspiration
entries: As a bonus action, Gro can inspire an ally within 30 feet to an enraged state of bloodlust for one minute. These followers gain 5 temporary hp, resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and vulnerability to psychic damage. All attacks made by Gro's followers are reckless, gaining advantage to hit enemies but granting enemies advantage on attacks against them.

trait.name: Resolute Followers
entries: Allies of Gro within 60 feet of her have advantage on Charisma and Wisdom saving throws.

action.name: Mace
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 3} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Rage Bomb (2/Day)
entries: As a bonus action, Gro can infuse one of her bloodbonded followers who is under the effects of Bloody Inspiration with a fatal fury. This magic causes the follower to foam bloodily at the mouth. If the follower is not slain before the start of the bloodbonded's next turn, the follower dies and explodes in a shower of superheated blood. Creatures within 10 feet must make a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw, taking 12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) fire damage on a failure and taking half damage on a success.

action.name: Blood Boil
entries: Gro targets a creature she can see within 60 feet and utters words of madness. The target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take 9 ({@damage 2d8}) fire damage as its blood superheats. Gro must be able to speak to use this ability.

reaction.name: Loyal Followers

footerEntries: For casting these spells, each hag is a 12th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as her spellcasting ability. The spell save DC is 12 + the hag's Intelligence modifier, and the spell attack bonus is 4 + the hag's Intelligence modifier.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, Hagne could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching her would feel her rough flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the hag is disguised.

While {@condition invisible}, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, so she can be tracked only by magic. Any equipment she wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with her.

spellcasting.name: Coven Spellcasting
headerEntries: While all three sisters are within 30 feet of one another, they can use a shared pool of spell slots to cast the following wizard spells:
footerEntries: For casting these spells, each hag is a 12th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as her spellcasting ability. The spell save DC is 12 + the hag's Intelligence modifier, and the spell attack bonus is 4 + the hag's Intelligence modifier.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: Apru can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Mimicry
entries: Apru can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dc 14} Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw}  {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: Apru covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The illusion ends if Apru takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies.

The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, Apru could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching her would feel her rough flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check to discern that the hag is disguised.

action.name: Invisible Passage
entries: Apru magically turns {@condition invisible} until she attacks or casts a spell, or until her {@status concentration} ends (as if {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell). While {@condition invisible}, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, so she can be tracked only by magic. Any equipment she wears or carries is {@condition invisible} with her.

trait.name: Amphibious
entries: The aglæcwif can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Keen Sight and Smell
entries: The aglæcwif has advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks that rely on sight or smell.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The aglæcwif regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the aglæcwif takes fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of its next turn. The aglæcwif dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The aglæcwif makes three attacks with its shortswords, or two claw attacks and a bite attack.

action.name: Shortswords
entries: {@atk mw}  {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw}  {@hit 7} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) slashing damage, and the target creature must make a {@dc 13} Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the creature is {@condition Grappled|XPHB}. When {@condition Grappled|XPHB} in this fashion, the aglæcwif has advantage on its bite attack against the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} target. The aglæcwif can only have one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} at a time.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw}  {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}16 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) piercing damage.

action.name: Control Water
entries: On its turn, the aglæcwif can cause one effect enumerated in the Regional Effects section. It can have up to three effects occurring simultaneously. It can cancel any or all of the effects at any time during its turn.
Regional Effects
When an aglæcwif establishes a lair, it gains control over the body of water surrounding the lair, creating the following effects:
The aglæcwif is immediately aware of any new arrival, whether object or creature, within the body of water within five miles of its lair.

The aglæcwif has a certain amount of control over the water around their lair. Within a mile of its lair, the aglæcwif can cause any of the effects enumerated in the {@spell Control Water|PHB} spell, can create a tidal wave (as per the {@spell Tidal Wave|XGE} spell), or can increase or decrease the temperature of the water within a range of up to boiling or down to freezing.

trait.name: Aura of Consumption
entries: This steed casts a long shadow. Whenever a creature that isn't undead takes damage while within 20 feet of a deathsteed, it takes an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) necrotic damage.

trait.name: Dissipate
entries: When the light hunter steed drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving no corpse.

trait.name: Trample
entries: If a creature is {@condition Prone|XPHB}, the steed can use a bonus action to make a hooves attack against it.

trait.name: Turning Bond
entries: If within 30 feet of its light hunter master, the light hunter steed can't be turned unless the same effect also turns the light hunter.

monster.name: Light Hunter

resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

languages: the languages it knew in life; telepathy 1 mile (with its steed only)

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the light hunter moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits with a weapon attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 14 ({@damage 4d6}) damage.

trait.name: Luminous Awe
entries: The light hunter is entranced by the light of the sun. If it sees sunlight (other than another light hunter), the light hunter must make a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition stunned} for 1 hour. The light hunter remains {@condition stunned} even if the light was created by a spell that ends before an hour has passed. However, this e ect ends immediately if the light hunter takes damage.

trait.name: Mounted Tactics
entries: The light hunter is bonded to a deathsteed. The hunter and its steed act on the same initiative, and the steed takes its turn after the hunter and has no restrictions on its actions. The hunter can force an attack that targets the steed to target the hunter instead. If the hunter's steed is destroyed, the hunter is dismounted but lands on its feet in a space of its choice within 5 feet of where the mount disappeared.

trait.name: Unholy Radiance
entries: Gleaming golden light glows from the light hunter's bones. It sheds bright light for 30 feet and dim light for another 30 feet. This light is sunlight. Creatures within either of these areas have Disadvantage on saving throws and take an additional 3 ({@damage 1d6}) radiant damage whenever they take damage from an attack or spell. {@spell Light|PHB} hunters and deathsteeds aren't affected by this trait.

trait.name: Turning Bond
entries: If within 30 feet of its deathsteed, the light hunter can't be turned unless the same effect also turns the steed.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The light hunter makes two sun saber attacks.

action.name: Sun Saber
entries: {@atk mw}  {@hit 8} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage and 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Radiant damage. If the light hunter is mounted and the target is a creature, the target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or fall {@condition prone}.

action.name: Summon Steed (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: A deathsteed appears in an unoccupied space the light hunter can see within 30 feet of it. This deathsteed is bonded to the light hunter, and it can't be summoned again until it is dismissed to a pocket dimension as an action, or it is destroyed. When summoned, this steed is restored to its hit point maximum. If the hunter enters an encounter riding the steed, this action requires recharge.

reaction.name: Solar Flare (Recharges after a Long Rest)
entries: When the light hunter is reduced to 75 hit points or lower, its full interior light blazes forth. All creatures within 60 feet of it other than other light hunters or deathsteeds must succeed on a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw or take 42 ({@damage 12d6}) radiant damage and be {@condition blinded} for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and isn't {@condition blinded}. While this reaction requires recharge, the light hunter takes an extra 7 ({@damage 2d6}) force damage whenever it takes damage from an attack or spell.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form.

While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walk speed is 5 feet, and it has a fly speed of 30 feet. Its statistics, other than size and sped, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

While in mist form, the vampire can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a fly speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and it is Immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Blood Detector
entries: If the vampire can smell a living humanoid that isn't protected by {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|PHB} or a similar effect, the vampire can recognize the scent if it ever meets it again. The vampire also knows if the humanoid is affected by a disease or curse, such as lycanthropy.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the vampire fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: When it drops to 0 hit points outside its resting place, the vampire transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling {@condition Unconscious|XPHB}, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed.

While it has 0 hit points in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then {@condition paralyzed} until it regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 hit points, it regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The vampire regains 30 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point, isn't in sunlight or running water, and hasn't taken radiant damage or damage from holy water since its last turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb

The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the vampire regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then {@condition buried|TPK} in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: The vampire targets one humanoid it can see within 30 feet of it. If the target can see the vampire, the target must succeed on a {@dc 19} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be {@condition charmed} by the vampire. The {@condition charmed} target regards the vampire as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the vampire's control, it takes the vampire's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for the vampire's bite attack.

Each time the vampire or the vampire's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the vampire is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Servants of the Night (1/Day)
entries: The vampire magically calls 3 blood trackers to its side, provided that the sun isn't up. The blood trackers arrive in {@dice 1d4} rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The blood trackers remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them as a Bonus Action.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: Kasimir is a 20th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 21}, {@hit 13} to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared:

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If Kasimir fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Power of the Sun
entries: Kasimir Sundrinker's personal might changes depending on how many conduit cores were disabled.

items.name: Zero Conduit Cores Disabled
entries: At the start of each of his turns, Kasimir Sundrinker gains 100 temporary hit points and regains 1 expanded use of his Legendary Resistance trait. With such powers, he is all but invincible.

items.name: Two Conduit Cores Disabled
entries: At the start of each of his turns, Kasimir Sundrinker gains 50 temporary hit points.

items.name: Four Conduit Cores Disabled
entries: Kasimir Sundrinker can't use lair actions.

items.name: All Conduit Cores Disabled
entries: Kasimir Sundrinker can't use legendary actions and loses all uses of his Legendary Resistance trait.

trait.name: Radiant Scourge
entries: When Kasimir casts a spell or uses an ability which deals necrotic damage, he can change the damage type of that spell or ability to radiant damage.

trait.name: Rejuvenation
entries: Unless his phylactery is destroyed, when Kasimir is destroyed he gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of his phylactery.

trait.name: Solar Absorption
entries: Whenever Kasimir is subjected to fire or radiant damage, he takes no damage and regains a number of hit points equal to half the fire or radiant damage dealt.

trait.name: Turn Resistance
entries: The lich has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead.

action.name: Searing Touch
entries: {@atk ms}  {@hit 10} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage, and the target ignites in flame. Until the target or another creature spends an action to extinguish the flames, it takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) fire damage at the start of each of its turns. In addition, it and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until it starts a turn while not on fire.

legendary.name: Cantrip
entries: Kasimir casts a cantrip.

legendary.name: Searing Touch
entries: Kasimir uses his Searing Touch.

legendary.name: Frightening Gaze (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: Kasimir fixes his gaze on one creature he can see within 10 feet. The target must succeed on a {@dc 18} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition Frightened|XPHB} for 1 minute. The {@condition frightened} target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Kasimir's gaze for the next 24 hours.

legendary.name: Disrupt Life (Costs 3 Actions)
entries: Each non-undead creature within 20 feet of Kasimir must make a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw against this magic, taking 21 ({@damage 6d6}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The Countess casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

1e: {@spell Vanish to the Space Between Worlds|guidedrakkenheim} *

trait.name: Devil's Sight
entries: Magical darkness doesn't impede the Countess's Darkvision.

trait.name: Shapechanger
entries: If the Countess isn't in sunlight or running water, she can use her action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into her true form.

While in bat form, the Countess can't speak, her walking speed is 5 feet, and she has a flying speed of 30 feet. Her statistics, other than her size and speed, are unchanged. Anything she is wearing transforms with her, but nothing she is carrying does. She reverts to her true form if she dies.

While in mist form, the Countess can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. She is weightless, has a flying speed of 20 feet, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, but can't pass through water. She has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, and she is immune to all nonmagical damage, except the damage she takes from sunlight.

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the Countess fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: Misty Escape
entries: When she drops to 0 hit points outside her resting place, the Countess transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling {@condition unconscious}, provided that she isn't in sunlight or running water. If she can't transform, she is destroyed.

While she has 0 hit points in mist form, she can't revert to her vampire form, and she must reach her resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in her resting place, she reverts to her vampire form. She is then {@condition paralyzed} until she regains at least 1 hit point. After spending 1 hour in her resting place with 0 hit points, she regains 1 hit point.

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: The Countess regains 20 hit points at the start of her turn if she has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the Countess takes radiant damage or damage from *holy water*, this trait doesn't function at the start of the Countess' next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: The Countess can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Forbiddance
entries: The Countess can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

trait.name: Stake to the Heart
entries: If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the Countess' heart while she is {@condition incapacitated} in her resting place, the Countess is {@condition paralyzed} until the stake is removed.

trait.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries: The Countess takes 20 radiant damage when she starts her turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, she has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack (Vampire Form Only)
entries: The Countess makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Unarmed Strike (Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw}  {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) bludgeoning damage. Instead of dealing damage, the Countess can grapple the target (escape {@dc 18}).

action.name: Bite (Bat or Vampire Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw}  {@hit 9} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is {@condition grappled} by the Countess, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and the Countess regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then {@condition buried|TPK} in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under the vampire's control.

action.name: Charm
entries: The Countess targets one humanoid she can see within 30 feet. If the target can see the Countess, the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Wisdom saving throw against this magic or be {@condition charmed} by the Countess. The {@condition charmed} target regards the Countess as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under the Countess' control, it takes her requests or actions in the most favorable way she can, and she is a willing target for the Countess' bite attack.

Each time the Countess or her companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until the Countess is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes a bonus action to end the effect.

action.name: Children of the Night (1/Day)
entries: The Countess magically calls {@dice 2d4} swarms of

legendary.name: Move
entries: The Countess moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary.name: Unarmed Strike
entries: The Countess makes one unarmed strike.

legendary.name: Bite (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The Countess makes one bite attack.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The blood sorcerer casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 13}, {@hit 5} to hit with spell attacks):

action.name: Call Forth Blood
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) Necrotic damage. Constructs and Undead are unaffected by this attack.

bonus.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}4 ({@damage 1d6 + 1}) Piercing damage. The target's Hit Point maximum is reduced by the damage dealt until they complete a Short Rest.

trait.name: Monster Lore
entries: The monster hunter adds its Proficiency Bonus (+2) to any Intelligence and Wisdom ability checks that relate to any two monster types, typically Monstrosities and Undead.

action.name: Greatsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Longbow
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 150 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d8 + 2}) Piercing damage.

reaction.name: Studied Response
entries: {@actTrigger} The monster hunter is targeted with a melee attack. {@actResponse} The monster hunter makes a Greatsword attack against the attacker before it attacks, doing an extra {@damage 1d6} Slashing damage on a hit. Additionally, the target has Disadvantage  on attack rolls against the monster hunter until the end of the monster hunter's next turn.

monster.name: Skeleton Rifler
languages: understands the languages it knew in life but can't speak

trait.name: Dead Rifle
entries: The rifle a skeleton rifler carries is nonfunctional as a ranged weapon for a creature other than a skeleton rifler. For the skeleton rifler, the rifle never needs to be reloaded.

action.name: Bayonet
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Dead Rifle
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 40/120 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d12 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: Rider's Sneak Attack (1/Turn)
entries: The outlaw deals an extra 10 ({@damage 3d6}) damage when it hits a target with a weapon attack and has Advantage on the attack roll, or when the target is within 5 feet of an ally of the outlaw that doesn't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition and the outlaw doesn't have Disadvantage on the attack roll. The outlaw can also deal this extra damage if it has moved 20+ feet this turn before making the attack, including on a mount.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Piercing damage.

action.name: Blackpowder Pistol
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 25/100 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Mobile
entries: Both the outlaw and its mount takes the Dash or Disengage action.

reaction.name: Uncanny Riding
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature the outlaw can see hits it or its mount with an attack. {@actResponse} The outlaw halves the attack's damage against itself or its mount.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: If the vampire is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, the vampire instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

trait.name: Feeding Frenzy
entries: When the vampire regains Hit Points from its Bite, it has Advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

trait.name: Forbiddance
entries: The vampire can enter a residence only with an invitation from one of that home's residents. If the vampire enters a house uninvited and involuntarily, it takes {@damage 1d10} Psychic damage at the end of each of its turns while it remains there.

trait.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
entries: While in sunlight, the vampire has Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The vampire makes one Bite attack and two Longsword attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d4 + 4}) Piercing damage. {@actSave con} {@dc 14}. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and the vampire regains Hit Point equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage, or 9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Slashing damage if wielded with two hands.

bonus.name: Teleport {@recharge 5}
entries: The vampire disappears in shadowy mist and teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 30 feet.

reaction.name: Horrifying Revelation
entries: {@actTrigger} A creature within 30 feet of the vampire deals damage to it. {@actResponse} {@actSave wis} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. If the target succeeds on its save or the effect ends for it, it is immune to this vampire's Horrifying Revelation for 24 hours.

monster.name: Alewife
languages: understands two languages but can't speak

trait.name: Flammable
entries: If the alewife takes Fire damage, it ignites. It and any creature it is grappling burn for 3 ({@dice 1d6}) points of Fire damage at the beginning of its turn. The alewife makes a {@dc 12} Dexterity saving throw to extinguish these flames at the end of each of its turns.

trait.name: Undead Fortitude
entries: If damage reduces the alewife to 0 Hit Points, it makes a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 5} plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a Critical Hit. On a successful save, the alewife drops to 1 Hit Point instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The alewife makes two attacks, one with its Claws and another with its Tentacles.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Slashing damage.

action.name: Tentacles
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage and the target gains the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition. The alewife may pull the target adjacent to the alewife.

bonus.name: Alcoholic Purge {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 13}, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. {@actSaveFail} 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Poison damage and the target has the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

action.name: Quill Arm
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d8 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: Death Note
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 30 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d8}) Psychic damage.

bonus.name: Danse Macabre
entries: The minstrel plays a magical requiem. Until the end of its next turn, Undead of the minstrel's choice within 30 feet that can see or hear the minstrel rolls {@dice 1d4} and adds the result to each ability check and saving throw it makes. This effect doesn't stack with others that grant similar bonuses, such as the {@spell Bless|PHB} spell. As a Bonus Action on subsequent turns, the minstrel can extend the requiem until the end of its next turn.

bonus.name: Horrid Mutation
entries: Eberhard's shadow can detach and attack as a shadow.

reaction.name: Inject Blasphemy
entries: {@actTrigger} Eberhard damages an opponent with his quill arm. {@actResponse} Eberhard injects ink from his quill into the damaged creature, causing a blasphemous sigil to appear on the target's flesh. The creature must succeed on a {@dc 13} Wisdom saving throw or have the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition until the end of their next round. A {@condition Charmed|XPHB} target must use its move and action to make a melee attack against a creature of Eberhard's choice.

trait.name: Borne of Darkness
entries: When the Strangleshade kills a creature, the body radiates Dim Light in a 10-foot radius for 1 minute. If, at the end of this time, the body is not in a brightly lit area, a Strangleshade emerges from the body's shadow.

trait.name: Strangling Grapple
entries: A creature {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by the Strangleshade at the start of their turn takes 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Necrotic damage and suffocates, gaining one level of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}. The creature can breathe again if they are no longer {@condition Restrained|XPHB} by the Strangleshade.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The Strangleshade makes two Tentacle attacks. If both attacks hit the same target, the target is {@condition Restrained|XPHB} (escape {@dc 13}).

action.name: Tentacle
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 10 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 ({@damage 1d4}) Necrotic damage. The Strangleshade can't use this action while Restraining a creature.

action.name: Shadow Bolt
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 60 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Quick Hide
entries: The Strangleshade uses the Hide action if in an area of Dim Light or {@spell Darkness|PHB}.

entries: Gnaardryn is studied in magecraft and can read texts and scrolls as a level 3 Wizard.

trait.name: Discerning

The mark ends early if Gnaardryn becomes {@condition incapacitated} or dies, or someone else marks the same creature. While the marked creature is within Gnaardryn's reach, it has disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than Gnaardryn.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Gnaardryn makes two attacks.

action.name: Longsword
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) slashing damage, or 8 ({@damage 1d10 + 3}) slashing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, and Mark.

action.name: Javelin
entries: {@atk mw,rw} {@hit 5} to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft., one target. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage and, if used to make a melee attack, and Mark.

action.name: Fire Breath
entries: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 10 (3d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.

action.name: Banner of Valor
entries: Once per day, Gnaardryn casts Haste on himself.

action.name: Ring of Jumping
entries: Gnaardryn casts Jump on himself.

reaction.name: Marked Control
entries: If a creature subjected to Gnaardryn's Mark moves while within 5 feet of Gnaardryn, Gnaardryn can make a melee attack against that creature. On a hit, the creature's speed drops to 0 until the end of their current turn.

monster.name: Ember Soul

trait.name: Fire Aura

action.name: Multiattack

reaction.name: Blood Boiling Scream

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
