entries: When the norn rolls for Initiative, they roll {@dice 3d20} and note down each result. When a creature the norn can see makes a {@dice D20} Test, the norn can choose to replace the number the character rolled on the dice with one of these results instead. Once a result has been used in this way, it is discarded.

trait.name: Nimble Movement
entries: The norn never provokes Opportunity Attacks.

action.name: Wilting Touch
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 3d6 + 3}) Necrotic damage.

bonus.name: Bolstering Spirit
entries: The norn chooses a creature I can see within 60 feet of itself. That creature regains 8 ({@dice 2d4 + 3}) Hit Points.

reaction.name: Swift Escape
entries: {@actTrigger} The norn is hit by a melee attack. {@actResponse} The attack misses and the norn moves up to its {@spell Fly|PHB} speed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting (Lizardfolk Form Only)
headerEntries: Urrix is a 5th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save {@dc 12}, {@hit 4} to hit with spell attacks). Urrix has the following spells prepared:

trait.name: Hold Breath
entries: Urrix can hold his breath for 15 minutes.

action.name: Multiattack (Lizardfolk Form Only)
entries: Urrix makes one Bite attack and one Claws attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d6 + 4} Piercing damage, or {@damage 1d10 + 4} Piercing damage in crocodile form. If Urrix is in crocodile form and the target is a Large or smaller creature, the target is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} (escape {@dc 12}). Until this grapple ends, the target is {@condition Restrained|XPHB}, and Urrix can't bite another target. If Urrix reverts to his true form, the grapple ends.

action.name: Claws (Lizardfolk Form Only)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 4} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 1d4 + 3} Slashing damage.

action.name: Change Shape (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
entries: Urrix magically polymorphs into a Crocodile, remaining in that form for up to 1 hour. He can revert to his true form as a Bonus Action. His statistics, other than his size, are the same in each form. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. He reverts to his true form if he dies.

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The havoc orb's spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save {@dc 20}, {@hit 12} to hit with spell attacks). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

trait.name: Blasphemous Geometry
entries: The havoc orb's form takes on the appearance of obscene angles and planes when looked at for too long, making it difficult for other creatures to focus on it. Its AC includes its Intelligence modifier.

trait.name: Fey Charm
entries: A supernatural attraction draws fey creatures to the havoc orb. At the DM's determination, such creatures treat the orb as a friendly acquaintance, as if under the effect of a {@spell charm person} spell. A creature not naturally inclined to follow the orb can resist this effect with a {@dc 20} Charisma saving throw. With a successful save, a creature becomes immune to that havoc orb's Fey Charm.

trait.name: Geometric Vision
entries: The havoc orb's extradimensional nature allows it to see around corners and behind objects, causing its attacks to ignore half cover and three-quarters cover.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The havoc orb has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Overreaching Enemy
entries: If an enemy misses the havoc orb with an opportunity attack provoked by the orb's movement, the enemy must succeed on a {@dc 16} saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Wild Magic Aura
entries: The havoc orb is a natural conduit for wild magic. Any creature casting a spell of 1st level or higher within 100 feet of the orb must roll a {@dice d20}. On a roll of 1, roll again on the Wild Magic Surge table (see the "Sorcerer" section in the Player's Handbook) to create a magical effect. The magical effect created cannot be affected or augmented by any ability the casting creature has. An effect that normally requires {@status concentration} does not require {@status concentration}, and lasts for its full duration. A havoc orb's spells are not affected by this feature.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The havoc orb makes two phasing claws attacks.

action.name: Phasing Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d8 + 3}) slashing damage, and the target must succeed on a {@dc 17} Constitution saving throw or gain one level of {@condition exhaustion}.

reaction.name: Deflecting Defense
entries: If the havoc orb has an enemy within 5 feet of it, it can nullify a weapon attack made against it by another creature by deflecting the attack toward that nearby enemy. The attack is made against the target enemy, and gains a +5 bonus to the attack roll. An enemy's attack cannot be deflected back against itself.

reaction.name: Magical Mettle {@recharge}
entries: If the havoc orb is the subject of a spell attack, it can ignore the effect of that attack.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The havoc orb makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Phasing Claws
entries: The havoc orb makes one phasing claws attack.

legendary.name: Eldritch Blast (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The havoc orb uses its eldritch blast.

monster.name: Pentacorn

spellcasting.name: Innate Spellcasting
headerEntries: The pentacorn's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save {@dc 18}). The pentacorn can innately cast the following spells, requiring no components:

trait.name: Charge
entries: If the pentacorn moves at least 30 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a horn attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra {@damage 5d8} piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 18} Strength saving throw or be knocked {@condition prone}.

trait.name: Magic Resistance
entries: The pentacorn has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: Magic Weapons
entries: The pentacorn's weapon attacks are magical.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pentacorn makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn.

action.name: Hooves
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 10d6} bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Horn
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 7} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 5d8} piercing damage.

action.name: Healing Touch (3/Day)
entries: The pentacorn touches another creature with its horn. The target magically regains {@dice 10d4} hit points. In addition, the touch removes all diseases and neutralizes all poisons afflicting the target.

action.name: Teleport (5/Day)
entries: The pentacorn magically teleports itself and up to three creatures it can see within 15 feet of it, along with any equipment they are wearing or carrying, to a location the pentacorn is familiar with, up to 1 mile away.

legendary.name: Hooves (Costs 4 Actions)
entries: The pentacorn makes one attack with its hooves.

legendary.name: Shimmering Shield (Costs 6 Actions)
entries: The pentacorn creates a shimmering, magical field around itself or another creature it can see within 60 feet of it. The target gains a +2 bonus to AC until the end of the pentacorn's next turn.

legendary.name: Heal Self (Costs 8 Actions)
entries: The pentacorn magically regains {@dice 10d4} hit points.

legendaryHeader: The pentacorn can take 15 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature's turn. The pentacorn regains {@dice 1d6} spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

trait.name: Keen Eye, Sharp Wit
entries: Dawderdale has Advantage on Initiative rolls.

trait.name: Sky-Eyed
entries: The captain has Advantage on ability checks and saving throws while aboard a skyship under sail.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The pirate makes three attacks, using Rapier or Pistol in any combination.

action.name: Rapier
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@damage 2d8 + 4} Piercing damage, and Dawderdale has Advantage on the next attack roll she makes before the end of this turn.

action.name: Pistol
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 4}, range 30/90 ft. {@h}{@damage 2d10 + 4} Piercing damage.

bonus.name: Bark Orders
entries: Dawderdale can Bark Orders at a non-player ship crew member within 30 ft. of her. That creature can use its Reaction to move up to half its Speed or make an attack.

reaction.name: Captain's Command (1/Day)
entries: When a friendly creature within 30 ft. fails an attack roll, Dawderdale can use her Reaction to call out a command to that creature. If the creature can hear the command, it can reroll the attack roll and use the higher result.

reaction.name: Riposte
entries: When Dawderdale is hit by a melee attack and is wielding a melee weapon, she can use a Reaction to add 3 to her AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss. On a miss, Dawderdale makes one Rapier attack against the triggering creature if within range.

trait.name: Deadeye Marksman
entries: Sylvio ignores half cover and three-quarters cover when making ranged attacks with a pistol. Sylvio has Advantage on ranged attacks with his Whispershot Rifle.

trait.name: Evasion
entries: When Sylvio is subjected to an effect that allows him to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, he instead takes no damage if he succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if he fails.

trait.name: Sky-Eyed
entries: While on a skyship, Sylvio has Advantage on saving throws.

trait.name: Sneak Attack
entries: Sylvio adds {@dice 1d6} to the damage roll of any attack if he has Advantage on the attack roll, or if a non-Incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of the target and Sylvio does not have Disadvantage on the attack roll.

trait.name: Whispershot
entries: On a critical hit, Sylvio becomes {@condition Invisible|XPHB} for one minute or until he makes another hostile action. The threshold for a critical hit on Sylvio's Whispershot attack roll die is lowered by 1. In addition, for each of the following that is true when he initiates the attack action, the threshold for a critical hit on the attack roll die is lowered by 1:
- The target cannot see him.
- No hostile creatures can see him.
- Combat has not started.
- Sylvio has Advantage on the attack.
- Sneak Attack is active on this attack.

action.name: Whispershot Rifle Attack
entries: {@atk rw} {@hit 9} to hit, range 120/240 ft., one target. {@h}{@damage 4d6 + 5} Piercing damage. This attack produces no flash or noise when fired.

bonus.name: Cunning Escape
entries: Sylvio takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

reaction.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries: If Sylvio is hit by an attack from an attacker he can see, he can expend a Reaction to halve the damage.

feat.name: Novice Raider
entries: You’ve received basic raider training from your allies.
Choose one skill associated with the ability score you improved with this feat, such as Stealth if you chose Dexterity. You have advantage on ability checks when using that skill.

feat.name: Cunning Raider
entries: You have a knack for ﬁnding the exact right time and place to strike during a raid—and more importantly, you always seem to know exactly where the best loot is hidden.

• You have advantage on one attack roll or saving throw that you make while raiding. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
• If you would fail a Stealth check during a raid, you can instead choose to succeed. Once this ability is used, you can’t use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
• When rolling for raid plunder, you can roll twice and take whichever result you prefer.

feat.name: Resolute Raider
entries: Just because raiding is chaotic doesn’t mean that you are. You are resolute, standing strong amidst the events that would unravel even your strongest opponents. When raiding, you:
• have {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to spells and effects that would alter or affect your emotions or mood.
• automatically succeed on {@variantrule Concentration|XPHB} checks.
• have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom-based ability checks and saving throws.

feat.name: Savage Raider
entries: You live for the chaos and convoluted moments that inevitably occur during raids.

• When raiding, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to move with supernatural alacrity. For one minute, you act as if you are aﬀected by the {@spell haste} spell. This eﬀect does not stack with {@spell haste} and can’t be dispelled. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining this ability after ﬁnishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

• You can choose to automatically succeed on one saving throw made during a raid. You can choose to use this ability after you roll the die but before you learn the outcome. Once this ability is used, you can’t use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
• When raiding, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ability checks and saving throws.

feat.name: Raid Commander

prerequisite.other: You have participated in three or more successful raids

entries: You’ve seen what can happen during raids and are generally prepared for it. When raiding:

• if one of your raiders that you can see or hear and that can hear or see you would fail an attack roll or saving throw, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to instead force that roll to succeed. This ability can only be used a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} during each turn of a raid.
• your allies within 10 feet of you that can hear or see you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the ﬁrst attack roll they make against a target.

• your allies can use the {@action Dodge} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on their turn so long as they are adjacent to you. This ability can be used even when you are {@condition Unconscious}, but not if you are {@variantrule Dead|XPHB}.

feat.name: Raid Leader

prerequisite.other: You have participated in five or more raids

entries: You’ve learned some hard lessons about the realities of raiding. Your presence is now more formal than active, but it is by no means diminished. Rather, your mere presence during a raid can bolster your raiders’ temperament and reinforce their resolve as they pillage and rampage. Raid commanders often defer to you for ad- vice, and less-experienced raiders know without a doubt that you are in charge. You gain the following beneﬁts due to your experience:
• When raiding, your raiders have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence and Wisdom saving throws so long as they can hear or see you or another ally with the {@feat Raid Commander} feat.
• You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on ability checks that you make as they pertain to your current, active raid.

feat.name: Solar-Powered Magic
entries: Choose any three spells you know or can prepare that deal damage. When you cast those spells, you can choose for them to deal radiant damage instead of their normal damage type. Each time you gain a level, you can choose three different spells to be affected by this boon

feat.name: Spark of Sunlight
entries: You are empowered by a spark of sunlight within yourself.

Once per day, when you drop to 0 hit points, you can drop to 1 hit point instead, and an arc of divine energy bursts forth from you. Creatures within 15 feet of you must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10 {@damage 3d6} radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a success.
You learn the following cantrips: guidance, resistance, sacred flame, spare the dying.
You learn {@spell Cure Wounds|PHB}, {@spell Healing Word|PHB}, and {@spell Revivify|PHB}. Once per day, you can cast {@spell Revivify|PHB} without using a spell slot or components.

feat.name: Circle of Danu - Aspirant
entries: Affiliation feat. You gain the following benefits.
You gain a +1 bonus to {@skill Nature}.

feat.name: Circle of Danu - Watcher
entries: Affiliation feat. You gain the following benefits.
You gain a +1 bonus to Passive Perception, Passive Investigation, and Passive Insight.

feat.name: Circle of Danu - Druid
entries: Affiliation feat. You gain the following benefits.
Once per day, you can cast any spell from the Druid list, so long as you have the ability to cast at least one spell of that level, without using a spell slot or components.

feat.name: Lives of a Fate Cat
entries: Story feat.

A Fate Cat has taken a liking to you, and it has affected your fate. When you fail a Death Saving Throw, you can choose to succeed instead. You may use this benefit three times. You recharge {@dice 1d3 - 2} expended uses at the beginning of each week. If the Fate Cat has chosen to accompany you on your travels, you recharge 1 expended use instead.

feat.name: Marked by the Beast
entries: Story feat.

You have been affected by a powerful totem to the Great Beast. While you are {@status Bloodied|XPHB} and within 5 feet of a {@status Bloodied|XPHB} enemy you can see, you must use your action to attack that enemy with a melee attack or Unarmed Strike for 1 minute. At the end of each turn this happens, you can end the effect by succeeding on a DC 15 Charisma saving throw. After you are affected by this, the effect is suppressed until you finish a Long Rest.

feat.name: Theresa Rests in Peace
entries: Story feat.
You gave Theresa eternal peace, avenging her death by taking revenge on her murders. Not only is her spirit now at peace, but she has gifted you with a limited power.
Once per month, you can roll {@dice 1d12} to do one of the following:

items: Roll the {@dice d12} and, as a Bonus Action, deal that amount of Fire damage to a creature within 5 feet of you, or
Roll the {@dice d12}, and, as a Bonus Action, restore that number of Hit Points to a creature within 5 feet of you.

feat.name: Theresa Rests in Flames
entries: Story feat.

You put Theresa's spirit to rest, but you failed to avenge her death by not bring her murderers to justice. Until you have {@spell Remove Curse|PHB} cast on you, take 2 additional points of Fire damage each time you take Fire damage.

feat.name: No Rest for Theresa
entries: Story feat.

You failed to both avenge Theresa's death by bring her murderers to justice and put her spirit to rest. A piece of her spirit haunts you. Until you have {@spell Greater Restoration|PHB} cast on you, you have Vulnerability to Fire damage, which overrides any Immunity or Resistance to Fire you might have had or might attain later.

feat.name: Arcane Parasites
entries: Thousands of unseen parasites within your flesh draw upon your arcane power. Effect You have a -1 penalty to spell save DC. Removal theoretically possible.

feat.name: Piercing Evoker
entries: Whenever you cast an Evocation spell that deals damage, you can choose for 10 points of the damage dealt by the spell to become untyped damage to which resistances and immunities do not apply.

spell.name: Blade Brothers
entries: You reach out and touch two creatures, forming a sparkling tether of multicolored light between them, visible only to you and to them. When one target of the spell attempts a saving throw, both targets can roll and apply the more favorable result. If both saving throws fail, both creatures suffer the consequences of a failed save. The effect ends if the creatures move more than 120 ft. away from each other.

spell.name: Blowback
entries: You compel a creature to attack itself with its highest-damage attack unless it succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, also forfeits its next Action.

spell.name: Dance of the Unicorn
entries: Whirling your pointed finger through a complex gesture, you create a cool and fresh mist that cleanses the air, washing it clean of nonmagical smoke, dust, and poisons. Everything within the mist has a +4 bonus on saving throws against gas effects and spells. The cloud of mist leaves everything within its area damp.

spell.name: Flameproof
entries: You render a creature or object you can touch (or yourself) immune to Fire damage for the duration.

spell.name: Magic Circle Against Chaos, Evil, Good, or Law
entries: You create a 10-ft.-radius, 20-ft.-tall cylinder of magic centered on a point on the ground that you can see. All creatures of your choice within the area are protected against creatures of an alignment of your choice.

Creatures of the chosen alignment have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the target. The target also can't be {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, or Possessed by them. A creature of the chosen alignment cannot enter the area unless it makes a Wisdom save.

If a target is already {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, or possessed by such a creature, the target has Advantage on any new saving throw against the relevant effect or effects, and immediately makes a saving throw against the relevant effect or effects. You and your allies inside the circle get a +2 bonus to AC and saving throws against creatures of the chosen alignment.

When you cast this spell, you can elect to cause its magic to operate in the reverse direction, preventing creatures of the chosen alignment from leaving the area and conferring the benefits of the spell on those outside the circle (within 10 ft.)
If you cast this spell with a higher level spell slot, it lasts an additional 10 minutes for each level above 2nd.
